column1: # Compatibility notes (Odin 2 Portal and other devices)
# Source of truth: your copy of this file. The database's compat_notes table is a
# queryable copy; it is WIPED and rebuilt from this file on every refresh.
# Key column: igdb_id (preferred) or store_ref (store:store_id fallback).
#   igdb_id   — fill this in once the game has been IGDB-enriched.
#               It is stable across DB rebuilds. Leave blank until known.
#   store_ref — e.g. "steam:400" or "gog:1207663233". Used as the key when
#               igdb_id is not yet known. Also a human-readable pointer.
#   Both blank → row is skipped with a warning.
# notes:          free text, no tab characters
# Keep your own copy at ~/.config/game-catalog/compat-notes.tsv (the scripts read
# that one when it exists); this repo copy is only the empty template.
